title_en: Free seats for poor children in private schools
law: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009, Section 12(1)(c)
rule_plain: Private unaided schools must keep at least 25 percent of seats in the first class for children from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups living nearby. These children study free until they finish elementary school. Disadvantaged groups include SC, ST, backward class children and children with disability. Weaker section means families with income below the limit set by the government.
what_you_can_do: Apply online on the Tamil Nadu RTE portal (rteadmission.tnschools.gov.in). Click 'Start Application'.
Fill in the child, parent and address details, upload the documents, and pick schools.
Keep ready: the child's photo, birth certificate, parent's Aadhaar or ration card, income certificate (weaker section), and community certificate (disadvantaged group).
For help, call the RTE Helpline 14417.
where_to_get_help: Directorate of Private Schools, Chennai. RTE Helpline 14417. Portal: rteadmission.tnschools.gov.in.

evidence.quote: Section 12 (1) (c) states that school specified in sub-clauses (iii) and (iv) of clause (n)

children belonging to weaker section and disadvantaged

an unaided school not receiving any kind of aid or grants
Child belonging to disadvantaged group means a child with disability or a child
belonging to the Scheduled Caste, the Scheduled Tribe, the socially and educationally
guardian whose annual income is lower than the minimum limit specified by the
AADHAR / Ration Card of Parent or Guardian
Income Certificate for Weaker Section Candidates
Community Certificate for Disadvantage Group Candidates
